selection.notes: GFX100S / 55mm. Noisy DSCF3879: ISO6400, f/1.7, 1/240s, 17:13:27. Reference DSCF3880: ISO100, f/5.6, 3s, 17:17:05. Captured 3m38s apart with nearly identical framing. Aperture, depth of field, clouds, lights and moving subjects still differ. Native sensor crops with input/reference-only integer coordinate matching; no resizing or warping, no per-panel brightness adjustment. Qualitative reference, not exact ground truth; evaluation-only, never training.

native_visual_review.interpretation: Both4000 arms remain visually close. Weak fabric strands are largely lost; leaves remain waxy and building detail soft. Fence wire structure is more coherent than RawNIND but soft. No consistent native expanded-corpus advantage. ISO100 is an independent optical/time reference, not exact GT.

decision: No promotion after original4000 schedules. Expanded early photo PSNR gain disappears; real-camera differences remain uncertain and native crops do not establish a broad advantage. Keep V43 step2000 and README reference. Reviewed83-ID data stays opt-in; a separate weak-procedural-source experiment may use fixed V54 control without claiming this corpus is globally preferred. No convergence, SOTA or speed-target claim.
